citation.title: Redundancy in regulation of lipid accumulation in skeletal muscle during prolonged fasting in obese men

reported.what: free fatty acids at 0, 48 and 72 h of fasting (FAST arm), n=9, as (geometric) mean [CI] with no level printed
3-hydroxybutyrate at 0, 48 and 72 h of fasting, same form
insulin at 0, 48 and 72 h of fasting; asymmetric intervals, so geometric means; the 0 h value (185 pmol/l) is not a fasted state
the only definition of the interval notation is 'mean [Confidence interval (CI)]'; no confidence level appears anywhere in the paper

detail: Every fasting value with a spread (Table 1) is a (geometric) mean with a bracketed CI whose confidence level (90, 95 or 99) is printed nowhere in the paper, the Methods say non-normal data are given as '(geometric) mean + [CI]' but the rows are not individually labelled as geometric or arithmetic, and the 0 h sample is not a fasted state (insulin 185 pmol/l); the CTRL 12 h fast is reported only as fold changes (Table 2, glucose 0.81), with no SD or SEM anywhere.
